metadata.title: Rigorous treatment of barycentric stellar motion: Perspective and light-time effects in astrometric and radial velocity data

notes: No star meets either contribution category. Table 1 (T:p11-b0; I:p11-b0) lists 33 Hipparcos entries selected solely for significant light-time effects over 100 yr (T:p10-b15), drawn from objects with XHIP radial velocities and ϖ > 10σϖ (T:p10-b16). Barnard’s star/HIP 87937 is used only as a high-proper-motion example (T:p10-b3; T:p9-b24; I:p9-b24). The paper discusses high-velocity stars generally (T:p1-b8; T:p12-b8) but never states that any named star is unbound from the Milky Way or establishes a satisfied unbound criterion, so no candidates_found or follow_up star is identified.
